title: The question-form chain reader passes a step code span that holds prose joined by ;
why: hooks/question_form.py's chain reader refuses a step code span that holds prose joined by `;`, such as `red flag; blue flag` or `the -x flag; the -v flag`. Found in #2024 round 2 (lane notes-fix-page, session_013NEJKzjkypcToggneCjJN8, 08:49 CST Nov 8). Main does the same.
note: A false alarm. How often a real step holds such a span is unmeasured, so the lane first counts them on the page and in step text; if none, this becomes a note, not a build (roles-findings-are-debts-or-notes). Done check: a red test where a code span of prose joined by `;` passes and a real shell chain is still read. Filed by triage 08:49 CST Nov 8.
